title: Localized consent banner tells the visitor how to refuse or withdraw consent

claim.statement: The rendered consent banner text for the locale tells the visitor how to refuse or withdraw consent.

question.instructions: The state is the visible text of a website cookie or consent notice, in any language. Does the text tell the visitor that they can refuse, reject or withdraw consent, or how to do so?

notes: Measured on the pinned checkpoint, CPU fp32, eval mode, one state per forward pass: formulation `noul` chosen on the calibration split only (highest accuracy, then lowest NLL at the fitted temperature). Held-out accuracy 0.641 (n=256); ECE (15 bins) 0.263 raw logits, 0.263 at the checkpoint's shipped temperature, 0.083 at the fitted temperature 3.375; at verify 0.85 / refute 0.85, coverage 0.086 (VERIFIED 20, REFUTED 2, INCONCLUSIVE 234) with gated precision 0.773 (Wilson 95% lower bound 0.566). Calibration split: accuracy 0.699, ECE after fitting 0.067 (n=256). Dataset: test/fixtures/system1-calibration/single-condition/consent-withdrawal/ (report: docs/calibration/system1-calibration-report.md, Hybrid section).

Formulations tried: noul: calibration accuracy 0.699, NLL 0.574 at T 3.375; held-out accuracy 0.641; choice2_neutral: calibration accuracy 0.531, NLL 0.662 at T 1.568; held-out accuracy 0.488; choice2_contrastive: calibration accuracy 0.500, NLL 0.689 at T 16; held-out accuracy 0.500; noul_sentence: calibration accuracy 0.684, NLL 0.549 at T 2.236; held-out accuracy 0.664. Controls at the fitted T: CTL-CONSENT-DE-COMPLETE VERIFIED->INCONCLUSIVE (p=0.818); CTL-CONSENT-JA-NO-THIRD-PARTY VERIFIED->INCONCLUSIVE (p=0.739); CTL-CONSENT-ES-NO-WITHDRAW REFUTED->INCONCLUSIVE (p=0.671). Replay: 5 runs per control (2 in fresh processes), max thresholded-probability delta 0, max logit delta 0; epsilon is 10x the larger of the measured delta and the delta the worst logit wobble seen on any checkpoint would cause at this temperature, rounded up.

Temperature semantics: `calibration.temperature` replaces the checkpoint's own temperature for this question's (type, option count) bucket, i.e. probabilities are softmax(option logits / T); a runner sets agent.temperature_by_options[temp_bucket] = T and passes no `lang`. `measured_ece` is the larger of the calibration-split and held-out ECE at the fitted temperature.

Held-out accuracy by variant (presence of purpose, third parties, withdrawal as 0/1): 000 0.44, 000_not_banner 0.56, 001 1.00, 010 0.38, 011 1.00, 100 0.16, 101 0.97, 110 0.12, 111 1.00. By language: de 0.59, en 0.66, es 0.66, fr 0.59, it 0.50, ja 0.78, nl 0.75, pt 0.59.

Formulations were registered in two stages: noul and choice2_neutral first; choice2_contrastive and noul_sentence after stage 1 failed on the calibration split (stage-1 held-out numbers had already been computed for two of the three disclosures). The choice among all four used the calibration split only.

Single condition: this rubric asks about one disclosure only. The consent-banner rule (purpose, third parties, withdrawal) holds for a locale when all three single-disclosure rubrics VERIFY on its banner; it replaces the multi-condition rubric RUB-S1-CONSENT-BANNER-DISCLOSURES, which scored at chance.

The held-out split is paraphrase-disjoint: calibration banners use the generator's original three paraphrases per disclosure and language, held-out banners two new ones, so held-out wording was never seen while choosing the formulation or fitting T. The paraphrases were written for this exercise; they are not reviewed native copy.
Checkpoint is pinned to laya-multilingual; Router auto-selection is not used. This checks that the disclosure is stated, not that the wording satisfies any particular law.

Not assurance-eligible: held-out gated precision 0.773 is below 0.95; Wilson 95% lower bound of held-out gated precision 0.566 (17/22) is below 0.90; controls land on the wrong status: CTL-CONSENT-DE-COMPLETE, CTL-CONSENT-JA-NO-THIRD-PARTY, CTL-CONSENT-ES-NO-WITHDRAW; controls off their expected status in a replay run: CTL-CONSENT-DE-COMPLETE, CTL-CONSENT-JA-NO-THIRD-PARTY, CTL-CONSENT-ES-NO-WITHDRAW. Thresholds were not lowered to compensate.
